about: 0130 A1-A2: when a Haiku `same` on two entity names merges by itself. Measured 2026-11-07 on 277 labelled pairs Haiku called the same: the lab's experiment 2 (dev 70, test 92, test2 65; two blind Opus labellers and a referee) and the owner's queue answers (50). A row is automatic only when its right/n meets the bar; every other `same` stays in the review queue. Change a row here, not the code (markx/identity.py reads it).

second.about: A held-back `same` whose every reason has a second row that is on, at >= min_conf, is asked again: the same guide (alias-v1) with two other example posts per name. Both `same` at >= min_conf: automatic, with its redirect (undoable). A disagreement stays in the queue, marked. Measured: these merges 71/71 right (held out of the guide's writing: 64/64), against alias-v2 (a stricter second-opinion guide) 78/79.

repairs.about: 0164 (markx/entity_repair.py): the identity repairs each run. org_family: a product family merged into an org is cut apart (automatic redirects undone; never the owner's). reparent: a version whose family is an org gets a family entity. families: families differing only by their maker's name or brand merge, then their same versions. suffix: orgs one once a corporate suffix goes merge only with min posts naming one beside the other's things (unmeasured: off sets the alias questions alone to decide). shown: the name and type shown, by evidence.

rows.why: the first opinion is 4/6 on a type mismatch; too few to trust
